prompt:
Our robotics firmware team has been building up engineering knowledge in an informal log file (`raw_engineering_log.txt` in the workspace root) over multiple sprints. We're onboarding new engineers and need this knowledge converted into a structured, machine-readable knowledge base that future AI agents can actually navigate and query.

Please process all the observations in that log file and store them as a well-organized set of memory notes in a file called `notes.json` inside a folder called `memory/`.

Important things we care about:
- Related observations (especially ones about the same subsystem) should be explicitly connected to each other.
- One of the later observations explicitly replaces an earlier one — the older note should clearly reflect that it has been superseded.
- The structure of each note needs to be consistent and rich enough for retrieval — not just a flat text dump.

The quality of the knowledge base is critical. We need this to be navigable by both humans and automated tools.
